What task, test, or improvement would you like to try? What should someone see when it works?

What plausible edit would look finished while missing a requirement or changing the wrong file?

How could someone check the difference? A few lines of synthetic input and expected output, or a description in your own words, are enough. If you have a shareable fixture, you can link it here.
